name: Tachibana Kazuhito
source:
“We can overcome anything as long as we're together!”

Returning to Advent City after two years, he spends lively days with both old and new friends. 

Cheerful and sociable, he deeply values his circle of friends.

Caught up in the Ruined World, he comes to confront the desires within himself and his companions, and what lies beyond them.

Class: Realist
Reality-Altering Ability: Visitor — a katana born from his wish to carve out the future.
